package.description: Find similar or identical images on Microsoft Windows, faster than ever.

en-US.description: Find similar or identical images on Microsoft Windows, faster than ever.
en-US.longDescription: Find.Same.Images.OK finds the same or similar images on all Microsoft Windows operating systems, and can also search for rotated, mirrored, or negative images.
en-US.name: Find.Same.Images.OK

zh-CN.description: 在 Microsoft Windows 上比以往更快速地查找相似或相同的图片。
zh-CN.longDescription: Find.Same.Images.OK 可在所有 Microsoft Windows 操作系统上查找相同或相似的图片，还可以搜索经过旋转、镜像或负片处理的图片。
